summary.text: Brett Barker is a Republican state representative who has represented Iowa House District 51 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Barker's career experience as a pharmacist and notes service as mayor of Nevada, Iowa.

paragraphs.text: Brett Barker earned a Doctor of Pharmacy from the University of Iowa, according to Ballotpedia.
Barker's career experience includes working as a pharmacist, and Barker previously served as the mayor of Nevada, Iowa, as well as a member of the city council.
In the 2025-2026 session Barker was assigned to the House Commerce, Economic Growth, House Human Resources (as vice chair) and Natural Resources committees.
